skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find an LCD for unlike denominators and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that common denominator.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with the same denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and interpreting a zero numerator as 0.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole parts without regrouping
skills.definition: Separate, subtract, and recombine whole-number and fractional parts when the fractional subtraction is nonnegative and no borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Regroup by borrowing from wholes
skills.definition: When the minuend fractional part is too small, borrow one or more whole units, convert them into denominator units, adjust the whole part, and complete the subtraction.

skills.name: Reduce fraction to lowest terms
skills.definition: Simplify a nonzero fractional result by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a shared denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an LCD or other common denominator for unlike denominators and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Mixed/whole part decomposition
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers and whole numbers as separate whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow across the whole-fraction boundary
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes as denominator-over-denominator fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify final fractional form
skills.definition: Express the final fractional result in acceptable simplest form by reducing common factors or converting a zero fractional part to an integer.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions or fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Align mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, or pure fractions in aligned whole-part and fraction-part form, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as d/d into the fractional part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify final form
skills.definition: Normalize the final answer by reducing a fractional part to lowest terms or replacing a zero fractional part with an integer result.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractions or fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Direct fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with an already common denominator when no borrowing across a whole-number part is needed, including reducing or normalizing the result.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Handle mixed-number or whole-number subtraction without regrouping by separating whole and fractional parts, subtracting whole parts, and recombining or omitting zero parts.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Handle mixed-number or whole-number subtraction with regrouping by representing missing fractional parts as 0/d, borrowing one or more wholes into the fractional part, subtracting the adjusted fractions, simplifying, and recombining.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, including zero-result cases.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a common denominator, preferably the LCD, and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Separate and recombine mixed or whole numbers
skills.definition: Represent mixed or whole-number operands as aligned whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts separately, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-sized fractional units when the minuend's fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend's fractional part.

skills.name: Reduce fraction to lowest terms
skills.definition: Simplify a nonzero fractional result by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.
